p_2d1f77d03c.sentence: If You Had to Watch a Stone for Five Minutes, Would Your “Bad-Guy Switch” Turn On?

p_ee502cde40.sentence: That goes on for five minutes.
p_ee502cde40.next: But you, the viewer, can still get one thing done: cut someone else’s reward.

p_9e7c56a55e.sentence: But you, the viewer, can still get one thing done: cut someone else’s reward.
p_9e7c56a55e.prev: That goes on for five minutes.
p_9e7c56a55e.next: This sounds grim all of a sudden, but it’s about an online experiment with participants in the United States.

p_0555f6fff1.sentence: This sounds grim all of a sudden, but it’s about an online experiment with participants in the United States.
p_0555f6fff1.prev: But you, the viewer, can still get one thing done: cut someone else’s reward.
p_0555f6fff1.next: They were randomly assigned to watch either a five-minute video of a stone, where nothing happened, or a video of a magician.

p_3b636d5b15.sentence: They could change it by 10 cents at a time, up to a maximum of 50 cents.
p_3b636d5b15.prev: During that time, they had three choices: reduce another participant’s reward, increase it, or do nothing.
p_3b636d5b15.next: The stone on the screen stayed silent, while the viewers were handed “a little power.”

p_f91dd7733d.sentence: Participants who were strongly inclined to enjoy seeing others suffer were more likely to reduce the other person’s reward after watching the stone video than after watching the magician video.
p_f91dd7733d.prev: So, did boredom become fuel for meanness?
p_f91dd7733d.next: Among those with a weaker tendency, there was no clear difference.

p_27fcf38dee.sentence: But there’s more to the story.
p_27fcf38dee.prev: You might want to dismiss this by saying, “So it really is a matter of personality.”
p_27fcf38dee.next: In the next experiment, participants were again randomly assigned to groups.

p_cc65c473d6.sentence: Well, if we focus only on personality, we may miss something.
p_cc65c473d6.prev: This time, regardless of how strongly participants were inclined to enjoy seeing others suffer, those who watched the stone video were more likely to reduce another person’s reward than those in the other conditions.
p_cc65c473d6.next: Along with “what kind of person someone is,” there’s also “what they can do in that situation.”

p_ba3de21e6b.sentence: The experiment also dealt only with brief boredom and actions that reduced another person’s reward.
p_ba3de21e6b.prev: We don’t know that offering an “increase” option can prevent meanness.
p_ba3de21e6b.next: We can’t apply its findings directly to everyday meanness or boredom that lasts a long time.
